changelog: Aura AI v2.4.3 — UI/UX Layout, Voice Dock & Question Dialog Optimization
Docked Question Card: Anchored to bottom sheet layout with full IME keyboard-awareness, dynamic scrollable options, and 48dp touch targets
Voice Screen Thumb-Zone Dock: Eliminated duplicate system insets and empty dead space under bottom voice controls (Screen, Mic, Language)
Clean Voice Status Hierarchy: Live dynamic status (Listening, Thinking, Working, Speaking) shown exclusively under top greeting; bottom center button dedicated to action (Mute/Unmute/Start)
Chat-Scoped Scroll-to-Bottom: Floating down-arrow button strictly scoped to Chat message list feed; removed root floating switcher overlay
Subtle Generation Stop Indicator: Clean neutral inline pill with StopCircle icon on user cancellation, eliminating harsh red error cards while preserving streamed output
